svg.title: Order of checks on a Claude Code tool call with mods
svg.desc: Managed PreToolUse hooks run first, then prepend-tier mods (your policy mod and sec-default), then user mods, then append mods, then other PreToolUse hooks, then the tool.check permission decision, then the tool runs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
